If a journal reference search contains a wildcard, matches will be made using wildcard matching as expected. For example, math* will match math , maths , mathematics . If a journal reference search does not contain a wildcard, only exact phrases entered will be matched. For example, math would match math or math and science but not maths or mathematics .
